eos_mask.decision: Mask the end-of-turn target of every document flagged as truncated.

flag.applies_to: every D2 registry document of a flagged rid whose tail is inside its row (documents.jsonl kept == length)

eos_mask.mask: CE, EOS and UL weight 0 (Q38 KL kept: at a mid-word cut the teacher's distribution predicts the continuation, not a stop) on global positions [e - 4, e - 1) with e = start + kept: the positions whose targets are <|im_end|> (248046), the newline (198) and <|endoftext|> (248044). Written as gt-mask spans in d2_mask_build's convention (per corpus file sha256, local rows, half-open columns; a span crossing a row boundary is split); the trainer's gt_spans path zeroes CE / EOS / UL (streamed_kd_trainer 1.3.4 :2729). Where an all-terms span covers the same positions (held-out documents) the all-terms mask wins.
eos_mask.guard: the lane refuses if any flagged document's last three ids are not [248046, 198, 248044] (all 6,936 are, measured)

other_sources.selfgen_rescore: 122 rows ended at the sampling limit; all 122 end on a non-EOS id (measured), so no end-of-turn target is trained after a cut: nothing to mask
other_sources.toolcall_selfgen: a row that did not end at an end-of-generation id is rejected at finalize; any such row found in the export gets the same mask

refill_policy.target: refill_target_tokens = the KD-carrying registry positions D2-X1 removes INSIDE the planned 18.85M registry draw, counted by the lane's mask build and printed in the applied receipt (expected about 2.96M: 3,095,968 over the whole registry x 18.85M / 19,689,472). The refill is counted in supervised (KD-carrying) tokens; the trainer census proves the total.

apply_before_first_step: 1. Build the D2-X1 all-terms spans and the D2-X2 gt spans (a d2_mask_build version > 1.1.0, written by the D2 lane, never by this file) from the sources above; check-doc-index against the packed files; refuse if a count differs from expected_counts without a written reason.
2. Re-check the 0-hit inputs (K3, long, self-gen rescore, BFCL-native) at build; run the 13-gram screen on the tool-call export.
3. Drop rows with no loss-carrying position from the registry draw; print refill_target_tokens.
4. Declare the refill sources (order, caps) in the D2 data config; the trainer census must show the trained-token total of the A2 plan.
5. Revise A2 (items 3 and 5) and re-run stage2_training_receipt.py check-prereg.
6. Write applied_receipt; d2_launch.sh refuses to start without it (gate added by the D2 lane).
